name: AI assistant help
description: Help mode entries for Molly's AI assistant plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: AI assistant
entries.text: The Dev Console's assistant, the same chat you have in the console: every provider, the console control API (open screens, change settings, run commands, file builds) and hands-free voice. Molly owns it here, so Ask the assistant anywhere in the console opens this window.

entries.title: Open the assistant
entries.text: Opens the assistant as a floating window over Molly (Molly menu → AI assistant, or the toolbar). The page button opens it in the main area instead.

entries.title: Hands-free voice
entries.text: Flips the assistant's hands-free switch: always listening for the wake word, replies read out loud. The same switch as Settings → AI assistant → Hands-free voice in the console and the microphone toggle in the chat header.

entries.title: Assistant settings
entries.text: Providers, behaviour, hands-free voice and tools live in the console's own settings (Settings → Plugins → AI assistant); this tab opens them and the assistant window.
